title: InvoiceBuddy · "The last evening of the month": storyboard v1 (example)
subtitle: A fictional product (project/product.example.md) · 12 shots · ~30 s after the cut · 16:9 · stage 3 board, before any keyframe exists. Render: python tools/storyboard.py examples/storyboard.json

sequences.name: 2 · Agitate and turn (0:11-0:21) · the pace tightens, then the riser cuts dead
3 · Solution, relief and CTA (0:21-0:31) · warm grade

shots.light: laptop glow in a dark kitchen
shots.action: Her eyes, reflected spreadsheet light flickering across them
shots.sound: fridge hum, one loud keyboard clack on the first frame
shots.why: Hook: a concrete pain in the first second, no product, no logo

shots.action: A small-business owner alone at the kitchen table, piles of paper, a cold cup of tea
shots.acting: shoulders up, leaning into the screen
shots.sound: room tone, a low drone begins
shots.why: Establish the world and the loneliness of the task

shots.action: Her finger hits copy, paste, copy, paste (screen content added in the edit)
shots.sound: keyboard clicks in rhythm with the cut
shots.why: Insert shots buy rhythm without new acting

shots.action: Her phone lights up face-down on the table; she turns it over
shots.why: The event lands on the hero

shots.action: A client in a shop, phone to his ear, waiting
shots.acting: calm, slow, unimpressed: the skeptic moves slower than everyone

shots.why: Agitate: the cost becomes a person

shots.action: The table from above: papers everywhere, the clock on the wall past eleven
shots.sound: ticking clock, drone at its peak
shots.why: Show time with a clock in the scene, never claim a number

shots.action: She stops, breathes out, opens the app on her phone (UI added in the edit)
shots.acting: the micro-pivot: exhaustion turns into decision
shots.sound: the riser CUTS DEAD on the tap
shots.why: The turn: lowest point, then the product appears

shots.action: The client's phone buzzes; he glances at it and nods
shots.why: The result the viewer can see is a reaction, not a feature list

shots.action: She closes the laptop, picks up the tea, leans back
shots.acting: relief in the shoulders, a small smile

shots.action: The phone on the table, screen dark; logo and CTA composited on the empty side
shots.sound: VO: "InvoiceBuddy. Your invoices, sent." then a final note
shots.why: Hold the end card 3-4 s; one CTA
